brief.prompt: A man in his early forties with naturally hooded upper eyelids stands in front of a bathroom mirror in soft morning window light, his forehead relaxed and gaze straight ahead as he studies his eye area. Clean, neutral bathroom with white tiles and a single plant, framed from the chest up so his face reads clearly at thumbnail size.
brief.alt: Man checking his hooded eyes in a mirror in soft daylight before deciding how to fix hooded eyes
brief.purpose: Introduces the article's main idea that fixing hooded eyes starts with calmly observing your own eye area in good light

review.alt: Man in his early forties with dark graying hair and stubble studies his eye area in a bathroom mirror, touching his temple near his brow, in soft window light beside a white-tiled wall and a potted plant.
